name: Golden Egg
cardTexts: Value is 100 times the number of eggs in your inventory
erratas: This treasure is an egg.
Golden Egg counts itself towards the total number of eggs in your inventory.

name: Fire Opal
cardTexts: Start of your turn: roll a die, this card's value is 100 times the result
erratas: When first drawn, roll a die for Fire Opal's initial value.
When Fire Opal is stolen or wagered by a player, card value does not change until the new owner's next turn.
When Fire Opal is in the Dragon's hoard, its value never changes. Except when playing with asymmetric mode, then roll a die at the start of the Dragon's turn for Fire Opal's value

name: Dragon Jade
cardTexts: +1 value to each of your dice
erratas: Dragon Jade's effect is only applied to the player's / Dragon's whose inventory / hoard this treasure is in.
Dragon Jade's effect is not applied when being contested for an encounter or wager.
Dragon Jade adds +1 base value to each of your die.
For example:
- When you roll 1 die, your total die roll value will be +1.
- When you roll 2 dice, your total die roll value will be +2.
- When you roll 3 dice, your total die roll value will be +3, etc.

name: Wyvern Ivory
cardTexts: Move to the Dragon’s hoard and draw 1 treasure card
erratas: You may use this treasure as an item to resolve its effect.
This card is still treated as a treasure card.
Do not trigger an encounter when using this card's effect.
Card interactions:
- You may use Orb of Ponderance in combination of this card
- You may use Djinn in combination of this card

name: Rainbow Scales
cardTexts: You cannot be targeted by a wager
erratas: No players can target the owner of Rainbow Scales in a wager, including the Dragon.

name: Crystal Claw
cardTexts: Add +10 value to your dice roll for a contest
erratas: Use this card to activate its effect. Discard it after use.

name: Red Diamond
erratas: One thousand. Good luck.

name: Iron Chest
erratas: Expansions interactions:
- Mythical Monsters: This card still adds +1 item slot for players with Cyclops

name: Molten Gold
cardTexts: Your negative treasures become worth +100. Your items become treasures worth +200
erratas: You cannot use your items with Molten Gold in your inventory.

name: Obsidian
cardTexts: When you roll a 1, place this treasure in any inventory (Dragon places in random player inventory)
erratas: For any dice you roll during any instance you roll a die, immediately resolve this card effect
Obsidian's effect is triggered on the base value of your roll, before being affected by other cards.
On a 1-on-1 against Dragon, when player rolls a 1, player may place Obsidian in the Dragon's hoard.
Expansions Interactions:
- Characters: Rolling for Proc ability will trigger this card
- Mythical Monsters: Rolling for Basilisk will trigger this card
